name: social-button
title: Social Button
description: One sign-in button with a provider prop (Apple, Google, GitHub, Discord, Microsoft, Figma, X, passkey, email link) and a flourish each: logos in currentColor at rest take brand colours only on interaction, then working, done and reset, or a shake on error
